shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/6546f876275d/workspace/round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/6546f876275d/workspace/round-brief.md; else echo '__NO_ROUND_BRIEF__'; fi
sed -n '1,260p' /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/6546f876275d/workspace/ticket.md
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
printf '%s\\n' '--- registry ---'
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- types ---'
rg -n \"ToolDefinition|ToolResponse|ToolDefinitionSource|inputSchema\" src/types src/orchestration | head -100
printf '%s\\n' '--- test setup ---'
rg --files -g '*test.ts' -g 'vitest.config.*' -g 'tsconfig*.json' | head -100

rg --files specs | head -50
printf '%s\\n' '--- commands ---'
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
printf '%s\\n' '--- acceptance (read only) ---'
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- jest config ---'
sed -n '1,200p' jest.config.js
printf '%s\\n' '--- lock ajv ---'
rg -n '\"ajv\"|node_modules/ajv' package-lock.json | head -30
printf '%s\\n' '--- installed ---'
if [ -d node_modules/ajv ]; then node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\"; else echo no; fi"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/|validated by|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80
sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"validated by|spec:\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' | head -100
sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
sed -n '1,240p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"#\\d+|spec anchor|anchor\" src scripts specs .lore | head -120
sed -n '120,180p' AGENTS.md
sed -n '1,120p' CONTRIBUTING.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md package.json package-lock.json
 timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md
 git diff --stat
 git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md package.json .lore/dod.md | sed -n '1,280p'
 git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git add .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git commit -m "feat(tools): validate registered input schemas"
git push origin HEAD'

git merge origin/main'
